intro: The Steak + Feta Pita from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) combines premium grilled steak with tangy Crazy Feta in a warm pita pocket. This protein-packed Mediterranean favorite delivers 44g of protein and 820 calories, making it a satisfying choice for meat lovers. Explore the [full CAVA menu](/menu) for more Mediterranean-inspired options.
priceCalories: Priced between $15.45 and $16.65, the Steak + Feta Pita contains 820 calories with a well-balanced macronutrient profile of 44g protein, 68g carbs, and 42g fat. This makes it one of the heartier options on the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas), ideal for those seeking a filling meal with substantial protein content.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this pita apart is the combination of tender grilled steak with bold Crazy Feta cheese, creating a rich Mediterranean flavor profile. The addition of pickled onions adds tanginess, while garlic dressing brings everything together. Fresh tomato, onion, and shredded romaine provide crisp texture, making each bite a balanced experience of flavors and textures.
nutritionFacts: With 820 calories and 44g of protein, the Steak + Feta Pita delivers substantial nutrition for an active lifestyle. The 68g of carbohydrates provide energy, while 42g of fat contributes to satiety. Compare nutritional details across menu items using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan meals that fit your dietary goals and preferences.
whatsInside: This curated pita features warm pita bread filled with savory grilled steak and creamy Crazy Feta. Fresh ingredients include tomato and onion salad, tangy pickled onions, and crisp shredded romaine. The signature garlic dressing ties all components together, creating a Mediterranean-inspired handheld meal that balances rich proteins with refreshing vegetables.
tasteLike: Expect bold, savory flavors from the grilled steak paired with the salty, creamy tang of Crazy Feta. The garlic dressing adds aromatic depth, while pickled onions provide acidic brightness that cuts through the richness. Fresh vegetables offer crisp, refreshing contrast to the warm steak and melted feta, creating a well-rounded taste experience in every bite.
customize: Customize your pita by exploring options from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) and [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings). Add extra vegetables, swap dressings, or include additional proteins to match your preferences. Consider adding avocado for creaminess or requesting extra pickled onions for more tang. Build your perfect Mediterranean wrap to suit your taste and dietary needs.
pairsWell: Pair your Steak + Feta Pita with options from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) like crispy pita chips or a refreshing side salad. Consider adding a dip from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) such as hummus or tzatziki. Complete your meal with a beverage from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) for a satisfying Mediterranean dining experience.
healthyChoice: This pita offers 44g of quality protein from grilled steak, supporting muscle maintenance and satiety. While containing 820 calories and 42g fat, it provides balanced nutrition for active individuals. The vegetables add fiber and vitamins, while feta contributes calcium. Consider portion sizes and pair with lighter sides to fit your nutritional goals and maintain a balanced diet.
howToOrder: Order the Steak + Feta Pita directly from the curated menu at any CAVA location or through their online ordering system. Find your nearest restaurant using [CAVA Locations](/locations). The pita comes pre-configured with all signature ingredients, but you can request modifications to suit dietary preferences or add extra toppings for a personalized touch.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greek Chicken Pita at 720 calories, the Steak + Feta Pita offers more protein and heartier flavor. The Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita contains 930 calories with different flavor notes. For vegetarian options, try the Crispy Falafel Pita at 750 calories. Each pita on the menu brings unique Mediterranean flavors to satisfy different preferences and dietary needs.
whoShouldTry: Ideal for meat lovers seeking a protein-rich Mediterranean meal, this pita suits those with hearty appetites. Athletes and active individuals will appreciate the substantial protein content. Fans of bold flavors, particularly those who enjoy steak and feta combinations, will find this pita satisfying. Anyone exploring Mediterranean cuisine or seeking filling lunch options should consider this choice.
worthTrying: The Steak + Feta Pita offers excellent value with premium grilled steak, quality Crazy Feta, and fresh vegetables wrapped in warm pita bread. Its bold Mediterranean flavors and high protein content make it a standout choice for satisfying hunger. While priced higher than some alternatives, the quality ingredients and generous portions justify the cost for a memorable meal experience.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the CAVA Steak + Feta Pita?
faqs.a: The Steak + Feta Pita contains 820 calories with 44g protein, 68g carbs, and 42g fat. This makes it one of the more substantial options on the CAVA menu, providing balanced nutrition for an active lifestyle.

faqs.q: What comes in the Steak + Feta Pita?
faqs.a: The pita includes grilled steak, Crazy Feta, tomato and onion, pickled onions, shredded romaine, and garlic dressing, all wrapped in warm pita bread. These ingredients create a balanced Mediterranean flavor profile with fresh and savory elements.

faqs.q: How much does the Steak + Feta Pita cost?
faqs.a: The Steak + Feta Pita is priced between $15.45 and $16.65, depending on your location. This price reflects the premium grilled steak and quality ingredients included in this curated pita option.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Steak + Feta Pita?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize your pita by adding extra toppings, changing dressings, or requesting ingredient modifications. Explore additional options from the toppings and dressings menus to personalize your meal according to your taste preferences and dietary needs.

faqs.q: Is the Steak + Feta Pita gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the Steak + Feta Pita contains pita bread which has gluten. However, you can check the CAVA Gluten Free Menu for alternative options or request your ingredients served in a bowl instead of pita bread to accommodate gluten-free dietary requirements.
